description:
Evaluate a saved strategy against current live market data to check if entry or exit signals are firing right now. Returns the current asset price and any order intents the signals would produce. It places no orders and opens no positions, but each call records the evaluation: it updates the strategy's last_evaluated_at and evaluation_count and adds an agent_evaluations audit row. Use it when the user asks whether a strategy should be entering or exiting at this moment, or wants the live signal state for a specific strategy. Over x402, a wallet that proves its identity (Sign-In-With-X) gets 30 evaluations free per UTC day, then 0.05 USDC each; an API key is covered by its plan.

[Access: pay 0.05 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]
name: evaluate_strategy
